_source: Modelled on the page's OWN published captions, read back from the Graph API on 2026-09-02 — not from a style guide. The last ten posts (30 Aug – 1 Sep) are the reference: «مباريات النهاردة ⚽ / كابتنك لعب ولا لسه؟ 🔥», «ترتيب الدوري بعد جولتين 🏆», «الأسعار اللي طلعت ونزلت الأسبوع ده 💰». One or two lines, one emoji at the end of a line, plain and conversational.
_whatChanged: v1 was abstract («يوم كامل كورة قدامك») and v2 was closer but still stiff («باب الجولة الرابعة فتح», «شوف ناديك واقف فين», «قولنا رأيك»), all rejected. The tell is padding: facebook.minEmoji was 2, which forced a second line onto captions the page writes as one. That floor is now 1.
_retired: 👇 and ownership percentages both appear in the page's AUGUST posts and in NONE from 30 Aug onward. They were dropped deliberately; the linter keeps 👇 banned and no template quotes a percentage.
_registers: ENGAGEMENT posts close on a question — matchday, matchdayFinal, question, podium, playerOfRound, teamOfWeek, topPlayers. INFORMATIONAL posts state and point forward — buildUp, deadline, priceChanges, leagueTable, results, resultsFinal. captions.mjs holds the list and lifts the linter's trailing-question ban for the first group only.
_vars: {matches} «ماتش واحد»/«ماتشين»/«3 ماتشات» · {these} «الماتش ده»/«الماتشين دول»/«الماتشات دي» · {remaining} matches left in the round · {rounds} rounds already played, «جولتين» · {deadline} «الاتنين 4 العصر» · {gw} «الجولة الرابعة». Arabic counts one and two in the noun, so these are pluralised in plan.mjs, never with a bare numeral. {winner} is the winning manager's name, and exists only once the round has settled.
